purpose: A rejected/retried step raised by another instance leaves this instance's idt accumulator untouched: v(out) = t.

oracle.derivation: Same closed form as a09_idt_ramp_clean: v(out) = t (LRM 4.5.4). N2 resolves rising zero crossings of sin(2*pi*(t-0.125)/0.25), i.e. t = 0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875 (LRM 5.10.3), each of which costs the host a rejected-and-retried step (LRM 8.4.7: a calculated solution may be accepted or rejected). N1 owns no event and no charge; per LRM 4.5.15 its accumulator advances once per ACCEPTED point, so the retries change the accepted grid and nothing else. Sample times are chosen clear of the four crossings.
